newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end higher but in range.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end higher but in range.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures finished higher on Thursday, but continued to struggle with a stubborn technical barrier where profit-taking was seen, dealers said.
The lead Nikkei 225 September contract added 205 points to end at 20,330, 10 points below its day high, on volume of 12,000 lots.
"We're still on a technical rebound, but it looks like there's quite a heavy top around 20,350-20,400," a trader at a Japanese brokerage said.
He said the market was likely to try to breach that level on Friday and could possibly head for 20,600.
"If we can't break through 20,350 tomorrow, we could test the 20,000 support again. But I don't see any immediate danger of falling below there," he said.
On Taiwan futures, the July MSCI contract ended sharply higher, gaining 15.1 points to 417.3 on volume of 1,805 lots.
